# High contrast in Remotion Studio<AvailableFrom v="4.0.542" />

Increase the contrast of text, focus indicators, and panel dividers in Remotion Studio. Defaults to `false`. You can toggle it in Settings → Studio → Interface while Studio is running.

## CLI flag

```text
--high-contrast
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setHighContrast(true);
```
